Your private checklist

Choose one broad goal to build a checklist.

Prepare step by step

  1. Define the age range, general location, schedule, transportation and accessibility needs without naming a child.
  2. Use official child-care and school sources to verify licensing, eligibility, enrollment and current availability.
  3. Ask providers directly about supervision, background checks, emergency plans, medication, accessibility and fees.
  4. Keep student identifiers, custody details, health records and account information off this public page.

General family-resource navigation only—not child-care placement, custody advice, licensing verification, educational determination or a provider endorsement.

Before you contact or choose a service.

  • Confirm current requirements, hours, eligibility, credentials, service area, accessibility, availability and total cost directly.
  • Keep names, narratives, account details, medical identifiers, child information and document text off this public page.
  • Directory appearance, order and paid status are not rankings, referrals, endorsements or proof of fit.
  • You choose whether to copy, print or share this plan; Franklin Navigator does not send it.
